definitions.tie_share: fraction of sister pairs with identical generation times, in logged steps
definitions.p_nt: fraction of non-tied pairs in which the larger sister's generation time is longer (X93's rule)
definitions.p_all: the same fraction with ties in the denominator counted as 'not larger' (X125b's rule)

verdict: the tie rule was the whole gap: ties are 22.2% / 21.5% of pairs, and with ties removed the larger sister's generation time is longer in 52.6% (CI [0.4932, 0.5574]) / 38.8% (CI [0.3561, 0.419]) of pairs, which brackets X93's 0.53 / 0.401. Counting ties as 'not larger' gives 40.9% / 30.5% — the same pairs, two statistics, and the earlier comparison set the tie-excluded proportion against the tie-counted one.
